community.joinBody: WITD is more than clothing — it's a growing group of people paying closer attention to how they move through their own lives. The community space is opening soon.

about.dreamBody: Most of life runs on autopilot — habit, reaction, the next notification. It has the texture of a dream: vivid while it's happening, hard to remember why you made half the choices you made.
about.observerBody: There's a part of you that notices the dream instead of just living inside it. WITD is built for that part — the observer behind the noise, watching, awake.
about.choiceBody: Waking up doesn't change the dream. It changes what you do inside it. Once you notice you're choosing, you can't fully go back to pretending you weren't.
about.symbolBody: Three arcs, one center. The arcs are the raw material of perception — what gets fed in. The bar at the center is the observer, the fixed point that decides what to do with it.
about.clothesBody: Heavyweight cotton, boxy fits, and small marks instead of loud logos. Built to be worn daily by people who'd rather the clothes stay quiet and let the wearer do the talking.
about.shippingBody: Orders ship within 3–5 business days from Toronto, Canada. Domestic shipping is flat-rate; free on orders over $150 CAD. International shipping times vary by destination.
about.returnsBody: Unworn items in original condition can be returned within 14 days of delivery. Reach out through the contact details below to start a return.

communityPage.title: More than clothing.
communityPage.body: WITD is for people paying closer attention to how they move through their own lives — to consciousness, creativity, and the choices that come with actually being awake for them. The clothing is one part of it. The community is the rest.
communityPage.openingSoon: The WITD community space is opening soon.
communityPage.dedicatedSpace: A dedicated space to connect with others who think the way you do is in the works. Sign up to the newsletter on the homepage to be the first to know when it opens.

hero.title: Wake in the dream.
hero.subtitle: You are here. Now choose how to move.

home.ideaBody: Reality can feel like a dream — vivid, moving fast, mostly on autopilot. WITD is for those who choose to become conscious inside it, and dress like they mean it.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.basicsBody: This describes what WITD collects when you use wakeinthedream.com, why, and who it's shared with. Using the site means you're okay with this policy.
privacy.orderInfoBody: — email, shipping address, and the items you buy, so we can fulfill and ship your order.
privacy.accountInfoBody: — email and a hashed password if you create an account, plus first name, last name, and age if you choose to add them. None of this is required to check out; guest checkout is the default.
privacy.paymentInfoBody: — we never see or store your card details. Payment is handled by our payment processor; we only receive confirmation that a payment succeeded.
privacy.discordBody: — if you connect Discord to verify community access, we receive your Discord user ID and confirmation that you hold the relevant role. We don't read your messages or server activity.
privacy.cookiesBody: — a signed session cookie if you log into an account, and your cart contents, stored locally in your browser so it survives a page reload.
privacy.sharedIntro: Only the service providers that need it to do their job — nothing is sold to anyone.
privacy.paymentProcessorBody: handles your payment — we never see or store your card details.
privacy.fulfillmentBody: print and ship your order, so they receive your name, shipping address, and items ordered.
privacy.emailProviderBody: sends account-related emails (verification codes, order confirmations).
privacy.imageHostBody: hosts product photography and isn't involved in handling customer data.
privacy.retentionBody: Order records are kept for accounting and warranty/return purposes. If you have an account, your profile stays until you ask us to delete it. Cart contents stored in your browser stay only on your device.
privacy.rightsBodyBefore: You can ask us what data we hold on you, correct it, or have it deleted — email
privacy.rightsBodyAfter: and we'll handle it. Deleting account data doesn't erase past order records we're required to keep for accounting.
privacy.childrenBody: WITD isn't directed at children, and we don't knowingly collect data from anyone under 13.
privacy.changesBody: If this policy changes in a way that matters, we'll update the date at the top. Continuing to use the site after a change means you accept the update.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.agreementBody: By placing an order or otherwise using wakeinthedream.com, you agree to the terms below.
terms.ordersPaymentBody: Prices are shown in CAD, USD, or EUR depending on your location and charged at checkout accordingly. We validate product, price, and stock server-side at the moment you check out — a price shown to you may change if a listing is updated before you complete payment. An order is confirmed once payment succeeds; you'll get an email confirmation.
terms.shippingBody: Orders ship within {{min}}–{{max}} business days. Shipping is a flat {{cadFlat}}, free on orders over {{cadFree}} ({{usdFlat}} flat / free over {{usdFree}} for USD orders, {{eurFlat}} flat / free over {{eurFree}} for EUR orders). We ship to {{shipsTo}}.
terms.returnsBodyBefore: Unworn items in their original condition can be returned within {{days}} days of delivery — see the
terms.returnsBodyAfter: section for how to start one.
terms.discountCodesBody: Codes earned on the site are single-use, expire one hour after being earned, and only apply to a first order on an email address with no prior completed purchase. We can void a code or cancel an order if we reasonably believe it was obtained through abuse of the system rather than genuine use.
terms.accountsBody: Creating an account is optional. If you do, you're responsible for keeping your login credentials confidential and for what happens under your account. Give us accurate info — it's what we use to ship your order and reach you if something goes wrong with it.
terms.ipBody: The WITD name, symbol, designs, and site content belong to WITD. Buying a product doesn't give you rights to reproduce the designs or branding.
terms.acceptableUseBody: Don't use the site to do anything illegal, attempt to compromise it, or interfere with other customers' use of it.
terms.liabilityBody: We aren't liable for indirect or consequential damages arising from your use of the site or products, beyond what's required by applicable law. Nothing here limits rights you have as a consumer that can't be waived under Canadian law.
terms.governingLawBody: These terms are governed by the laws of Ontario, Canada.
terms.changesBody: We may update these terms; the date at the top reflects the latest revision. Continuing to use the site after a change means you accept it.
